authority: apostila-cga-2026; adversarial review of phase two, gaps P2 and P3
method: all 24 occurrences of system.service, all 18 of `bolsa de valores` and all 21 of the provider forms read one by one
reason: Three surfaces owned by the wrong concept, and one promotion this phase made without measuring — the same defect I had just diagnosed in the `vendido` guard entry.

operations.why: system.service carries `domains: [software, infrastructure]` and means `a software process that performs a defined function for other components`. All 24 of its corpus matches are financial or legal — `empresas de serviços financeiros`, `contrato de prestação de serviços`, `bens e serviços`, `conjunto de serviços relacionados ao funcionamento do fundo`. Zero correct. I promoted `serviços` in amendment 22 with the justification `Plural of serviço` — a morphological argument, exactly the entry-by-resemblance I had just removed from the `vendido` guard in the same phase.
0 of 24 correct against the concept's own definition.
Same reasoning on the English side, so `entity.service` can own the ordinary sense.

entity.securities is `tradable financial instruments as defined by the securities regulator`. The corpus says `A Bolsa de Valores é um mercado organizado e regulado` and contrasts it with the OTC market — it is the venue. This form was added in round 1 as a phrase anchor to save the occurrences `valores` lost when it was demoted: it preserved the SPAN and attached the wrong concept. entity.stock_exchange now owns it.

The concept is defined as `the administrator or manager`. The material explicitly contrasts `prestadores de serviços essenciais` with `os demais prestadores de serviços`, so the bare plural is the general term and belongs to actor.service_provider.
